Operational systems

One Toolkit, several command layers

The interface remains map-first. Large systems are constructed on demand and can be enabled only when they are operationally useful.

Mission command

Mission Age map timers

Displays compact age timer badges above personal missions on the map.

Fleet and transport

Vehicle Code Status

Summarises vehicle status codes, descriptions and counts.

Map operations

Toolkit Command Palette

Searches live missions, personal vehicles, buildings, locations, Settings cards and safe Toolkit actions from one responsive surface.

Alliance operations

Alliance Member Manager

Filters and sorts alliance members by role and current activity, with explicit sequential loading of additional pages.

Browse all features
Responsive operation

Desktop, tablet and iOS

Persistent settings and purpose-built layouts keep the Toolkit usable across large maps, touch screens and Safari on iPhone.

Desktop

Full map workspace with complete command panels.

Large displays, mouse and keyboard operation, multi-panel monitoring.

Tablet

Landscape-optimised touch controls fitted to available map space.

iPad and tablet operation with readable persistent controls.

iOS Mobile

Safe-area-aware Safari layout with mobile controls and viewport recovery.

MissionChief operation from iPhone with minimal map obstruction.
